story.title: How it all began
story.paragraphOne: What started as a chance encounter became the most beautiful story of our lives. Merle and Lasse met when life seemed to have other plans – yet everything felt exactly as it was meant to be.
story.paragraphTwo: Together we have laughed, argued, travelled and dreamed. Every moment together is a gift. And now we are looking forward to celebrating the most beautiful day of our lives with the people who mean the most to us.
story.quote: I choose you – today, tomorrow and every day after.

dressCode.title: Dress Code
dressCode.intro: We would love to see you in elegant festive attire. Here is our colour palette for inspiration.
dressCode.note: This is only meant as inspiration and we completely understand if you do not own these colours. We kindly ask you to avoid pure white, black or bright red – all other colours are very welcome.

message.paragraphOne: Every relationship is a journey, and we are incredibly grateful that you are part of ours.
message.paragraphTwo: From the very first moments together to this special day – you have supported us, encouraged us and shared countless laughs with us.
message.highlight: Thank you for celebrating with us. We can't wait to create unforgettable memories together.

contacts.title: We're Here for You
contacts.bottomText: Whether you have organisational questions, need accommodation tips, or simply want a friendly chat – these wonderful people are happy to help.
